scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/worker/server.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/worker/server.mjs && bun build src/runner/server.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/runner/server.mjs
scripts.deploy: pnpm turbo run build --filter @prisma/example-cron... && ( set -a; . "${PRISMA_DEPLOY_ENV:-../../.env}"; set +a; bun ../../node_modules/.bin/prisma deploy ${CRON_STACK_NAME:+--name "$CRON_STACK_NAME"} )
